images.title: Base, height, area
images.purpose: Shows the core move of the practice: pick a base, find its perpendicular height, take half the product.
images.composition: One triangle, large and centred, with its base horizontal and height drawn inside.
images.exact_structure: Plain white background, lots of empty space, the figure large and centred, thin dark outlines. Only the labels listed appear; no other text, no scenery, no characters. Triangle with a horizontal base 4 units long and a top vertex 3 units above the base, positioned above a point 1.5 units from the left end of the base (the foot of the height lies inside the base). The triangle is filled light teal (#0072B2). The base is drawn as a thick amber (#E69F00) line. The height is a reddish purple (#CC79A7) dashed vertical line from the top vertex straight down to the base, with a small right angle mark at its foot. Label base 4 cm under the base, height 3 cm beside the dashed line, and below the figure the line 1/2 × 4 × 3 = 6 cm².
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The height is the perpendicular to the chosen base, and area is half of base times height.
images.description: Shows the core move of the practice: pick a base, find its perpendicular height, take half the product.
images.context: Uses the first practice item: base 4 cm, height 3 cm, area 6 cm².
images.teaching_notes: Stress the right angle mark: a slanting side is never the height.

image_decisions.why: The practice has no interactive tool, so one clear base and height picture anchors every item.
